citeinfo.title: Sediment-Hosted Stratabound Copper Assessment of the Neoproterozoic Roan Group, Central African Copperbelt, Katanga Basin, Democratic Republic of the Congo and Zambia

descript.abstract: The Esri shapefile CACB_orebodies is a spatial database that provides spatial and descriptive information for sediment-hosted copper orebodies of the Central African Copperbelt, Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Zambia.
descript.purpose: The spatial database was created for use in a geographic information system (GIS) as part of Scientific Investigations Series Report 2010-5090-T, which is part of the USGS assessment of undiscovered copper resources of the world. It provides locations of the areal extent of orebodies, in addition to descriptive information for use in a GIS and for estimating undiscovered mineral resource endowments.

idinfo.useconst: This spatial database is not meant to be used or displayed at any scale larger than 1:1,000,000 (for example, 1:500,000).

attracc.attraccr: The attributes associated with this dataset were derived from reports and maps.

dataqual.logic: No duplicate spatial features exist in the dataset.

horizpa.horizpar: Locations were derived from maps varying from 1:1,000,000-scale to 1:4,000-scale.

srcinfo.srccontr: Sources provided locational (mixed scales) information for orebodies. Full references are provided in the accompanying "GIS references.xlsx" file.

procstep.procdesc: Source maps were scanned and registered using georeferencing tools in ArcGIS 9, using a variety of source material as a guide. Features were manually digitized from georeferenced maps in GIS. Fields were attributed using information from maps and reports.

enttyp.enttypd: Esri shapefile of the areal extent of sediment-hosted copper orebodies in the Central African Copperbelt, Africa

attrdomv.udom: Sequential unique whole numbers that are automatically generated.

attr.attrdef: Name of group to which orebody belongs. Groups represent clusters of deposits which are grouped together using the 500 m aggregation rule (and for which resource data are aggregated) in order to describe and model grade and tonnage; correlates to Group_name in CACB_deposits_prospects.shp.
Name of deposit to which orebody belongs; correlates to Name in the shapefile CACB_deposits_prospects.shp.
Short reference; abbreviated citation for reference; full reference is provided in accompanying "GIS references.xlsx" file.
Area of the areal extent (as projected to the surface) of the orebody, in square kilometers.
